# Copilot coding-agent guidance — Rotmg-bin

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), repository governance and current open issue/PR state. **This public historical bot repository is not a live game-automation or unattended agent assignment permission.**

- Work only on a specifically approved bounded issue with explicit offline acceptance, no file overlap, actual owner claim and rollback. Unknown work state, `blocked`, `needs-review`, `needs-human` and unverified protections are ineligible.
- Never run the real game bot or GUI automation against game clients/accounts, invoke live trade execution, bypass anti-cheat, read account credentials or publish private game/user material.
- Preserve upstream author credit/licence. Branches and PRs in this repository are publicly visible; no secrets, user data, unreleased private content or internal security details in commits, comments or prompts.
- Use topic PRs and synthetic/offline tests, not direct `master` pushes. Record temporary active claim/UTC time, exact head, source review and test outcomes. Up to two known nonoverlapping supervised developers/project but **no unattended account-global dispatcher** or paid worker activation.
- Verify current PR-only protection, required exact-head offline CI and security review before merging; [#15](https://github.com/Refusing1310/Rotmg-bin/issues/15) remains an administrator-sensitive gate. There is no basis to assume current `master` enforcement from old docs or a successful optional workflow.
- The 9 November standing policy waives separate PO sign-off for **non-public integrations only** when real branch safeguards pass. A public software release or live deployment still requires exact-candidate security/design summary, independent applicable release review and explicit PO approval. No permission to weaken branch rules, pay for services or publish.
- N-CODE and the private company site remain higher priority until 18 November.
